summary:
The existing release workflow has an exclusive occupancy-only mode selected by original candidate run ID and expected artifact ZIP SHA256, with publish/readback inputs empty. Resolver, product tests, packing, candidate location, publication and published-version readback jobs are excluded even for partial occupancy input. The selected job has contents/actions/packages read permission and a six-minute timeout; early malformed/mixed input refusal precedes downloads and signature-verifier setup.

The maintained runner authenticates a successful same-repository manual release run, its complete bounded artifact listing and exactly one unexpired coherent artifact. Native artifact digest and downloaded ZIP must match the selected expected hash. Only nine regular retained v4 files are admitted within archive/expanded-size limits. The original manifest source must equal the original run source; the current verification checkout never becomes the old package source. Existing custody verification precedes the strict occupancy checker with --candidate and no candidate-only Unknown exception. Denied, missing or incomplete feed evidence refuses and remains Unknown. Signature-aware comparison may invoke the pinned SDK verifier, without a product build/install/test or package push.

Source controls exercise runner ordering, original-source binding, artifact substitution/expiry/ambiguity, ZIP path refusal, actual early guard execution, release-job isolation, custody failure, denied feed evidence and timeout. These synthetic controls and source delivery are not actual authenticated occupancy, feed availability, publication, promotion or consumer acceptance. readback_version still requires a published tag and cannot qualify an unpromoted candidate. Publication retains its own same-head candidate custody, gates and fresh occupancy; earlier candidate observations and unknown operations are not overwritten or released.
title: Retained candidate occupancy is read-only and keeps original source custody
